description: Modify existing maps; the affected map files / MapInfos.json are written immediately. `action` selects the edit: "fill_layer" overwrites an ENTIRE tile layer with one tile ID (destructive, not undoable; layers: 0-1 ground, 2-3 upper, 4 shadow bits 0-15, 5 region IDs 0-255; tileId 0 clears; find valid IDs with get_project_context detail "tileset"); "set_display_names" sets the player-visible displayName of several maps at once (entries whose map file is missing are reported in `skipped`, not errors); "organize_tree" re-parents maps in the editor tree (purely organizational, gameplay unaffected); "connect" creates a bidirectional pair of transfer events between two maps so the player can walk both ways; "set_encounters" sets the map's random-battle list so enemies appear while walking — `encounters` is [{troopId, weight?, regionSet?}] (weight default 5; regionSet [] = whole map; troopId must exist) plus optional `encounterStep`. WITHOUT encounters set, a map has no random battles. Returns a per-action summary. Fails with an error if a referenced map does not exist (except set_display_names, which skips). "paint" writes one tile into cells or a rect of one layer; an autotile is written as its kind and the painted cells and their neighbours get the shapes the editor would give them, so shorelines and walls join up, while the rest of the map keeps its saved shapes. "repair_autotiles" fixes only autotile cells whose shape the engine cannot draw (analyze_project validate reports them as invalid-autotile). For event-level work use manage_map_event.

action.description: Which edit to perform; see the tool description

cells.description: action "paint": [[x, y], ...] cells to paint (or give rect)

encounterStep.description: action "set_encounters": average steps between random battles (default 30)

encounters.description: action "set_encounters": [{troopId, weight?, regionSet?}] random-battle entries; troopId must exist (create via create_database_entry "troops")

folders.description: action "organize_tree": [{mapId, parentId}] — parentId 0 means root level

names.description: action "set_display_names": [{mapId, name}] — name is what the player sees on map entry

posA.description: action "connect": transfer event position on map A {x, y, trigger} (trigger 1=walk-on default, 0=action button for doors)

posB.description: action "connect": transfer event position on map B {x, y, trigger}

rect.description: action "paint": {x, y, width, height} rectangle to paint (or give cells)

tileId.description: actions "paint", "fill_layer": tile ID (0 = clear); on layer 5 a region id 0-255

name: edit_map
